title: Website Metadata, Open Graph, and SEO Reference

failureModes.symptom: Every link previews as the home page

failureModes.symptom: Google shows a title you did not write

limitations: X (Twitter) card documentation returned HTTP 402 on 2026-08-11; every X image constraint and character limit here is second-hand.
Apple's Smart App Banner page returned no readable body; its parameters are second-hand.
Discord, Telegram, and LinkedIn publish no formal metadata specification; their behaviour is reported by agreeing third parties.
Bing's webmaster guidelines page returned no readable content; Bing-specific behaviour is absent except for IndexNow.
Platform caches, crop ratios, and limits change without announcement; this is a point-in-time reading of 2026-08-11.
No effectiveness measurement was performed. This report covers what platforms accept and read, not what improves clicks or rankings.
Title and description character figures are display conventions. Google states there is no limit and truncates to device width.
Only Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic crawler tokens were confirmed against vendor documentation.
